observed_value: principal_amount_usd missing on 7 rows flagged as non-USD debt
anchor_value: All investments are denominated in United States Dollars.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: All investments are denominated in United States Dollars.

rationale: FX01 assumes these seven debt positions have non-USD source principal and therefore require a separate USD conversion. The filing's Schedule of Investments footnote explicitly states that all investments are denominated in United States Dollars. Thus missing principal_amount_usd is not an FX defect for these rows; the check fired from an incorrect non-USD currency classification.
